notes.title: Version 1.0.9_20240422 Update
notes.notes:
【Optimization】


 Optimized the Lockpick mini-game:
[olist]
 Added temporary judgment for the correct unlocking area, so even if the lockpick breaks and re-enters, the correct area will not reset.
 The correct area will reset when the game restarts.
[/olist]



 Optimized the Four Divine Beasts Cave:
[olist]
 Adjusted some treasure chests to increase coin rewards or replace them with item rewards.
 Adjusted some treasure chests to contain equipment such as "Hurricane Feather Ring," "Red Demon Horn," "Flame Demon Horn Ornament," or "Blue Silk Neck Flower Knot."
 Added footprints hints in the Xuanwu Cave ice skating maze.
[/olist]



 Optimized the Dark Forest:
[olist]
 Lowered the speed of Spirit Archers, Spirit Mage Archers, and Dark Bees.
 Added bee-related information to the rest cabin.
 Widened some roads on certain maps.
[/olist]



 Optimized the mini-game "Brave vs. Baldies":
[olist]
 Reduced the selling price of skill books from 500 to 300.
 Reduced the selling price of Chicken teammates from 500 to 300.
 Added an additional aquamarine crystal collection point.
 Replaced the starting herb with a red potion.
 Adjusted the skills of the character "Elf": removed healing, changed revival to the first skill, and added the second skill "Magic Arrow." Equipment for Elves also adjusted accordingly.
 Downgraded the effect of the Warrior's "Storm Sword" and upgraded the effect of "King's Sword."
[/olist]



 Adjusted the structure of the Rest Spring event: Returning to the Rest Spring in Chapter Nine allows you to obtain a small boat. (Finally, the weird item setting can be obtained. Prepare yourself if you want it!)
 Adjusted the items sold at the Undersea Tunnel Camp, adding Troll's Codpiece (for removing wetness).
 Added a hint in Chapter Four's South Village challenge against the Three Muscular Brothers: Press SHIFT to view detailed skill information.
 Added a flashpoint hint to the signboard in the High Ridge Wilderness in Chapter Nine.
 Adjusted the flow of the mini-games "Beauty Puzzle Joy" and "Maituan's Beauty Puzzle Joy": At the beginning, the complete picture will be briefly displayed to provide a hint.


【Bug Fixes】

 
 Fixed some typos in the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8_20240409 Update
notes.notes:
【Optimization】

 Updated JS data.


【Bug Fixes】

 Fixed a bug where some weapons' basic attacks were affected by silence.
 Fixed a bug with the Miracle Synthesis Potion.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7_20240313 Update
notes.notes:
【Optimization】

 Reduce the damage immunity of the "Green Spirit's Protection" status from 900 to 750.


【Bug Fixes】

 Some maps and performances within the game have broken graphics.
 Fixed a bug in the new version of the skiing mini-game where the tutorial image sequence was incorrect.
 Fixed a bug where equipment couldn't be replaced normally for the player during certain storyline segments.
 Fixed a bug where replaying "Seeking Flowers and Asking Willows" caused game malfunctions.
 Fixed a bug where automatic skills would cause the game to freeze under specific conditions.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6_20240306 Update:
notes.notes:
【Optimization】

 Corrected the incorrect numerical description of "White Tiger Holy Robe" and adjusted the ability values of "Black Tortoise Holy Robe" accordingly.
 When confused monsters flee, it will not affect the player.
 Optimized some NPC's images.
 Adjusted reflection and counterattack.
 Optimized team mechanism.
 Optimized the aerial view special effects when first seeing the world map.


【Bug Fixes】

 Fixed a bug where the video on the cabinet in the "咕咕咕's Room" could not be played.
 Corrected the guidance error in the mission journal of the capital city's side mission "Observation in Detail".
 Fixed a bug where under specific conditions, falling from the ground in the White Tiger Cave would teleport to the wrong map.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5_20240222 Update:
notes.notes:
【Optimization】

 After defeating the evil dragon, added a bit of dialogue for the passerby (dragon).
 Improved the book contents in the 8th ruins.
 Replaced the tutorial image for the skiing mini-game and increased the health of the brakes.
 Removed the "immortal" status from certain boss battles.


【Bug Fixes】

 Fixed typos and some map glitches within the game.
 Fixed a bug where basic attacks with the bow weapon did not grant TP.
 Fixed a bug in the mini-game "1A2B" where entering "0000" did not reset the step count.
 Fixed a bug where the circus master being petrified caused the battle to be unable to end.
 Fixed a bug where "the circus master Throwing Knives" actions did not end the game even after throwing 30 knives.
 Fixed a bug where players could infinitely obtain hidden treasures on the ship.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4_20240219 Update
notes.notes:
【Optimization】

 Replaced WangTiger's facial portrait in the seventh village.


【Bug Fixes】

 Fixed a bug where after Zhuque's revival, it became impossible to kill her.
 Corrected an error in the eighth village where not receiving a quest after talking to XIA-CI.
 Fixed abnormal display of Harry in the Sword Lake.
 Corrected  the skill "Little Rabbit" in the "Brave vs. Baldies".

notes.title: Version 1.0.1_20240218 Update
notes.notes:
【Optimization】


 Optimized the special effects when first seeing the world map.
 Reduced the evasion rate of enemies in the first six chapters.
 Added messages when entering the Otherworldly prison without obtaining key items.


【Bug Fixes】

 Corrected typos and map in various parts of the game.
 Fixed the issue where after WEI-PEI leaves the first village, drinking could trigger the "Jiahao's Secret" quest again.
 Fixed the issue where talking to Jiahao again after WEI-PEI leaves the first village would incorrectly label the player as a thief, regardless of whether they had actually stolen anything before.
 Fixed incorrect teleportation points in the Dark Forest.
 Fixed graphical display error of a certain chest on the 3rd floor of the Golden Temple.
 Fixed the issue where the "Doctor Event" would trigger repeatedly at the gate of the capital city.
 Corrected incorrect display of some book titles in the dialogue of the "Ambitious Heart" quest.
 Fixed the issue in the capital city arena where there was no message when lacking money.
 Fixed positioning error of NPCs during storyline events in the eighth village.
 Fixed time judgment error in the mini-game "Beauty Puzzle".
 Fixed incorrect staircase patterns in the team leader's "Spot the Difference" mini-game.
 Fixed event errors in the ice skating area of Xuanwu Cave.
